ownership: Maryland publisher source records and U.S. Census Bureau boundaries; derived source relationships remain distinct from both originals
scope: Internal source-point-to-Census-county relationships for the fixed retained Maryland center cohort only
allowed_use: Offline county overlay after exact retained-source and Census input verification
Internal versioned derived relationships with original source and metadata lineage
prohibited_use: Claims of verified premises or current operations
metadata_retention: Preserve complete acquisition-time item metadata and notices unchanged; include their exact retained artifact and payload hashes in derived metadata
retention: Preserve immutable source, predecessor and successor releases with run-scoped evidence. No automatic source replacement or deletion.
redistribution: Internal derivative only; no public record-level export is enabled. Original notices and metadata remain unchanged.
personal_data_handling: Relationships reference existing candidate IDs; do not copy names, contact fields or business polygons, or enrich people. Existing protected source records remain separately governed.
authorization_basis: User-directed governed geographic processing; retained item notice permits derived data with Maryland acknowledgment and unchanged metadata. This policy governs a new processing step, not retroactive acquisition authorization.
coordinate_basis: Provider-transformed EPSG:4326 source point; address accuracy and premises unverified
